sources.title: ILOSTAT — Profil pays Bénin
sources.scope: National labour-market context; not an individual occupation wage table.
sources.limitation: The source currently identified does not provide a validated low/median/high salary range for each of the 115 M-TIER occupations.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Outlook Handbook — occupational pay, education and outlook (May 2025 estimates)
sources.scope: Occupation-specific median wages and, for many occupations, 10th/90th percentile annual wages and outlook; US only. Six exact M-TIER occupation matches are included in salary_estimates_v3.3.json.
sources.limitation: Exact occupation match required. These figures are US employee wages and cannot be reused as estimates for another country.

sources.title: BLS Occupational Employment and Wage Statistics — May 2025 tables
sources.scope: National, state, metropolitan and industry occupation wage estimates for approximately 830 US occupations; May 2025 dataset published 15 May 2026.
sources.limitation: Requires validated SOC match; use the appropriate percentile and wage definition. US only.

sources.title: Government of Canada Job Bank — wage reports
sources.scope: Low, median and high wages by occupation and Canadian location.
sources.limitation: Requires verified NOC mapping and geographic selection for each occupation.

sources.title: INSEE — salaires et revenus salariaux
sources.scope: French wage statistics by socio-professional category and territory.
sources.limitation: Not every M-TIER occupation has a direct PCS-level match; broad category averages must not be presented as occupation-specific estimates.

sources.title: ONS — Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings
sources.scope: UK earnings statistics by SOC occupational classification.
sources.limitation: Requires verified SOC mapping; some public tables are aggregated at broad occupation levels.

sources.title: ONS Annual Survey of Hours and Earnings — 2026 provisional, occupation tables
sources.scope: UK annual paid-hours and earnings estimates by occupation; 2026 provisional edition released 22 October 2026. Four-digit SOC dataset also available.
sources.limitation: Must validate the matching SOC 2020 code and distinguish provisional from revised estimates.

sources.title: INSEE — Salaires dans le secteur privé par catégorie socioprofessionnelle détaillée
sources.scope: French net full-time-equivalent salary data by detailed socio-professional category; dataset updated 9 October 2026.
sources.limitation: Private-sector scope excludes some occupations/sectors; PCS matching must be exact and net amounts must not be mixed with gross estimates.

sources.title: ILOSTAT — Earnings and income data catalogue
sources.scope: Official catalogue includes average hourly and monthly earnings by sex and occupation in local currency, and median earnings by occupation and currency where reported.
sources.limitation: Catalogue presence is not itself a matched observation. Download, observation period, country, currency, ISCO code, population scope and occupation mapping must be verified for each record.

sources.title: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics — OEWS May 2025 tables
sources.scope: Official US occupational wage estimates with 10th, 25th, 50th, 75th and 90th percentile wages for published occupations.
sources.limitation: US-only; a SOC occupation match is required. Do not transfer values to another country.
